Bio ELECTRA and its further pre trained version Bio ELECTRA+ show promising performance on biomedical question answer, relation extraction, yes/no question classification, question answer ranking and biomedical named entity recognition tasks and are suitable alternatives to BERT and Bio BERT for biomedical text mining.

, we have shown that small ELECTRA based models are comparable to BERT in terms of performance and can be trained on consumer level hardware.

small, discriminatively pretrained models such as Bio ELECTRA and its further pre trained version Bio ELECTRA+ are competitive with large models such as BIo BERT for biomedical text mining tasks and are more suitable for real world applications.

Bio ELECTRA and its variant Bio ELECTRA+ show competitive or better performance on several biomedical text mining tasks compared to BERT and Bio BERT, while being much faster to train and much smaller in model size, making these models more suitable for practical applications in the biomedical domain.
The main takeaway from our work is that
small, discriminative language models such as ELECTRA are effective for biomedical text mining tasks and can be trained from scratch with limited computational resources and data.
, for biomedical text mining, Bio ELECTRA and its pre trained version Bio ELECTRA+ show comparable performance with smaller model size than BERT and Bio BERT.
